method: Decode the two embedded PNGs without modification; compare every ARGB pixel using System.Drawing.Bitmap.GetPixel on Windows.
interpretation: Differences lie along the selected translucent stem. Cesium's Entity static color batch quantizes ColorGeometryInstanceAttribute to unsigned bytes, while the candidate PolylineCollection supplies a floating-point material color. This is consistent with an alpha-precision difference, but an alternative renderer has not yet been tested to establish causality.
disposition: The direct-collection prototype fails exact visual equivalence and is not enabled in production. No pixels are masked and no tolerance is relaxed.
